# Pagination

## Pagination family

The pagination bar and its satellite rows.

### Decisions

The rows carry no roster flags. PaginationSkeleton composes SkeletonText
bars; the widths are the contract's skeleton cells, not the upstream
placeholders' literal widths.

### Platform

`platform.support` is `both`: the rows render on the web and natively from
the same source.

## Pagination

Pagination is a bar that pages through a list, with a page-size select, item counts and previous and next buttons.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `controllable-state` |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `backwardText` | `string` | no | Tooltip/name of the previous-page button. Default "Previous page". |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Disables the whole bar. |
| `forwardText` | `string` | no | Tooltip/name of the next-page button. Default "Next page". |
| `onChange` | `function` | no | Called with `{ page, pageSize }`. |
| `page` | `number` | no | The 1-based page for the controlled form. |
| `pageSize` | `number` | no | Items per page; defaults to the first of `pageSizes`. |
| `pageSizes` | `array` | no | The selectable page sizes. |
| `pagesUnknown` | `boolean` | no | When the total is unknown: no page select, forward always live. |
| `size` | `string` | no | One of `sm`, `md`, `lg`: the bar's height. Default `md`. |
| `totalItems` | `number` | no | The item count the bar pages through. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the bar. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `height` | `size.size_medium` |
| `heightSmall` | `size.size_small` |
| `heightLarge` | `size.size_large` |
| `dividerWidth` | `control.pagination_divider_width` |
| `paddingInline` | `control.pagination_padding_inline` |
| `textGap` | `control.pagination_text_gap` |
| `selectPaddingStart` | `control.pagination_select_padding_start` |
| `selectPaddingEnd` | `control.pagination_select_padding_end` |
| `collapseWidth` | `control.pagination_collapse_width` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"pageSize":10,"pageSizes":[10,20,30,40,50],"totalItems":103}` |
| sm | `{"pageSize":10,"pageSizes":[10,20,30,40,50],"size":"sm","totalItems":103}` |
| lg | `{"pageSize":10,"pageSizes":[10,20,30,40,50],"size":"lg","totalItems":103}` |
| lastPage | `{"page":11,"pageSize":10,"pageSizes":[10,20,30,40,50],"totalItems":103}` |
| disabled | `{"disabled":true,"pageSize":10,"pageSizes":[10,20,30,40,50],"totalItems":103}` |
| unknown | `{"pageSize":10,"pageSizes":[10,20,30,40,50],"pagesUnknown":true,"totalItems":103}` |
| selectHover | `{"pageSize":10,"pageSizes":[10,20,30,40,50],"totalItems":103}` |

## PaginationNav

PaginationNav is a row of page buttons with overflow pickers and previous and next buttons.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `controllable-state` |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `itemsShown` | `number` | no | Pages to show when the window is wide enough. Default 10. |
| `loop` | `boolean` | no | Whether the direction buttons wrap past the ends. |
| `onChange` | `function` | no | Called with the selected page index. |
| `page` | `number` | no | The 0-based selected index for the controlled form. |
| `defaultPage` | `number` | no | The initial index for the uncontrolled form. |
| `size` | `string` | no | One of `sm`, `md`, `lg`: the page buttons' height. Default `lg`. |
| `totalItems` | `number` | no | The number of pages. Default 0. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the nav. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `height` | `size.size_large` |
| `heightMedium` | `size.size_medium` |
| `heightSmall` | `size.size_small` |
| `paddingInline` | `control.pagination_nav_page_padding_inline` |
| `focusWidth` | `control.pagination_nav_focus_width` |
| `indicatorHeight` | `control.pagination_nav_indicator_height` |
| `indicatorWidth` | `control.pagination_nav_indicator_width` |
| `breakpointSm` | `breakpoint.sm` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"itemsShown":5,"totalItems":10}` |
| md | `{"itemsShown":5,"size":"md","totalItems":10}` |
| sm | `{"itemsShown":5,"size":"sm","totalItems":10}` |
| middle | `{"defaultPage":4,"itemsShown":5,"totalItems":10}` |
